name: rockbuilt
description: Installs and updates the Rockbuilt harness in a project repo (vendored, so cloud routines, Cursor and Codex see it too): EARS specs, verifiable tasks, planner, implementer, verifier and blind auditor separation, three review levels computed from the diff, a code-enforced merge gate, owner approval only for schema, architecture, auth model, cost and irreversible changes (or a recorded delegation), and a nightly cycle that sends one message per run.
